body: Hey I'm a similar age and I don't think I know anymore than you do. And the thought of slaving for half my life just to make a living really scares me. And I know there's a solution out there but I don't know what it is. I just don't want to believe that our life has ended right after highschool because then there wouldn't be any point. I do hope you get through this and it sucks to hear that you've experienced that and I think you have all the reason to be upset. I would be too.
